```{python}
#| label: start-spark

import sparknlp
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark: SparkSession = sparknlp.start()
```

```{python}
#| label: download

from gutenbergpy.textget import get_text_by_id, strip_headers
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

@F.udf
def download_book(id):
    raw = get_text_by_id(id)
    text = strip_headers(raw).strip().decode("utf-8")
    return text

books = spark.read.csv(
    "books.csv",
    header=True,
    schema="author STRING, type STRING, title STRING, id INT"
)
books = books.withColumn("text", download_book(books.id))

books.show()
```
